body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics introduced its new digital camera lineup 'SL102' for 1Q, 2009 at 2009 CES.
Featuring 3x optical zoom, Digital Image Stabilization technology, and a 2.5 inch LCD, the SL102 can record MJPEG / VGA video, and the SL420 can record MPEG4 / SVGA video.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
